name: Closed eyes speech
description: One person makes a speech while the other listens with presence. The speech is done with closed eyes.

name: Vocal emphasis speech
description: One person makes a speech while the other listens with presence. The speaker focuses on picking one word from each sentence and putting vocal emphasis on the chosen word to channel their intention

name: Pauses emphasis speech
description: One person makes a speech while the other listens with presence. The speaker focuses on clear pauses between each sentence

name: Story without body language
description: One person makes a speech without body language while the other listens with presence
iteration: Do the same speech again, but this time you can make a single gesture per sentence and the hands go back

name: No words, just gesticulations story
description: One person makes a speech while the other listens with presence. The speech is done using gesticulation, sounds, emotional expressions etc, but no words
iteration: The listener repeats everything adding the words

name: Balanced share
description: One person shares something they are happy about in their life and another thing they are concerned about
iteration: Listener goes to reflect on what was said

name: Exaggerate the story
description: One person tells a story. The listener names emotions and the speaker has to enact these in the speech making them exaggerated.

name: Word relations
description: One person says 3 related words, last one becomes the target for the other person.

name: Pick up the cup
description: 2 lines facing each other, in the midle of each pain there is a cup, you follow instructions like touch head or turn around until you hear pick up the cup

name: No words scene
description: Pair of people have to act out a scene without giving any words eg. “you are late and have to get breakfast, walk the dog and get a shower”

name: Scenes from casual talk
description: Two people sit talking casually, once you spot something funny take someone from the audience and make a scene from it

name: Tree
description: One person in the middle of the circle takes a pose saying I am xyz and other people join until we have a 3 or other number, the rest returns, last person stays and repeats what they are, next round begins
variant: You can add that the first person says at the end what they pick with them, leaving only single person

name: Freeze
description: Two person in the middle of the circle do a scene. At any time someone can shout freeze and take spot of one of the people kicking off someting completely brand new

name: Props
description: Two people are doing a scene, and each of them has an assistant. Whenever the speaker needs somethign in the scene, they reach out to the assistant and they procure someting for them

name: One word expert
description: A few people stand shoulder to shoulder to speak as one expert on given topic (mundane, fruit, science, controvertial). They say words one by one and facilitator throws questions at them.

name: One word pairing
description: Warmup for one word games. Pair up and describe together objects around the room using one word at a time

name: High five
description: Stand in the circle, one person steps in the middle and share sometihng about themselves, other people who have something in common high five them

name: Peer introductions
description: Find pairs, preferrably people who dont know eachother. Have them introduce to each other and ask people to listen to eachother
iteration: In front of the whole group each person introduces the other to everyone

name: DOWN
description: Hey X (hey what), Hey X (hey what), Show us how to get down (na ah), Show us how to get down (okej) <D O W N thats the way to get down + dance + repeat>

name: Gestured intros
description: One by one everyone in the circle says their name and makes a gesture, then everyone repeats the gesture saying welcome + name

name: Superpowers
description: One on one people introduce and come up with the superpower for eachother, then in circle they introduce the other person with tyeir superpower

name: Gift for your hobby
description: One to one people introduce their hobby or what they like doing after work the other person replies by giving them an imaginary gift, rhen in the circle we share what gifts we got

name: Word relations
description: go around the circle coming up with related words, be fast
iteration: We rewind to bring these all back from memeory

name: Hive mind
description: Everyone walk around randomly, a word is said and everyone starts repeating

name: Pass the clap
description: In the circle, lock eyes, time the clap, pass it on

name: Woosh
description: Pass the whoosh to the right, boink to reverse, pow to pass accross

name: Blue ball, red ball
description: Pass the blue ball, then red one, then green one and so on. It works in the circle with parallel balls flying around

name: Related words barrage
description: In the circle one person comes up with the word. Now rest throws in one related word to the root one, dont duplicate

name: Pointers loop
description: In the circle, everyone raises their hand, points at someone who has their hand up, we assemble a pattern that loops

name: Mind melt
description: In the circle, two people come to the middle and say a word on a 3, the goeal is to have the same word. You can use the guide of 2 words mentioned previously or same seed

name: Responses
description: Make a line, one person stands in front, at the head of the line, they will respond in exaggerated way to something very casual and boring the line person starts with, then they move to next person

name: Backline story
description: One by one people go into chronological line adding on their one sentence to the story.

name: One word at a time story
description: One by one people say single word that creates a story. Variants can be with letter of complaint, breakup letter.

name: Tadada
description: With rhythm, we go around the circle, person (A) says a random word, then next (B) says next one related and we say previous (A) + next (B) + tadada. Then B becomes start for the next round

name: You look like potato
description: One person makes a pose, other comment on what it actually is.

name: Catch the sound
description: In circle, one person makes a sound to pass, the receiver repeats it and throws new one
